nothing-happens.title: Start your code
nothing-happens.text: Code needs a "hat block" on top to tell it when to start. Try "when green flag clicked."

pointers.label: Drag "when green flag clicked" into your code

green-flag.title: Run your project
green-flag.text: Click the green flag above the stage to run your project!

pointers.label: Click this green flag to start!

move-sprite.title: Move a sprite
move-sprite.text: Make your sprite move with the "move" block

move-with-keys.title: Keyboard controls
move-with-keys.text: Use "when key pressed" with a motion block to control your sprite with the keyboard

pointers.label: Drag "when key pressed" into your code

change-xy-position.title: Change x
change-xy-position.text: Use "change x by" for left and right movement

pointers.label: Drag "change x by" into your code

go-to-position.title: Go to a spot
go-to-position.text: Use "go to x y" to put your sprite in a specific place

pointers.label: Drag "go to x: y:" into your code

add-sound.title: Add a sound
add-sound.text: Go to the Sounds tab to add sounds, then use the "play sound" block

pointers.label: Then play sounds with a block

record-sound.title: Record a sound
record-sound.text: In the Sounds tab, click the microphone button to record your own sound!

play-sound-until-done.title: Wait for sound
play-sound-until-done.text: "Play sound until done" waits for the sound to finish before continuing to the next block.

pointers.label: Drag "play sound until done" into your code

say-think.title: Speech bubbles
say-think.text: Use the "say" or "think" blocks to make a speech bubble appear

change-costume.title: Change costume
change-costume.text: Use "next costume" to change how your sprite looks, and animate it

add-costume.title: Add costumes
add-costume.text: Go to the Costumes tab, then click the cat button at the bottom to add a new costume

animate-costume.title: Animate
animate-costume.text: Put "next costume" inside a "forever" loop to make a simple animation

forever-loop.title: Repeat forever
forever-loop.text: Use a "forever" block to make something repeat over and over

repeat-loop.title: Repeat 10
repeat-loop.text: Use "repeat" to do something a specific number of times

too-fast.title: Slow it down
too-fast.text: Add a "wait" block to slow things down

use-variables.title: Make a variable
use-variables.text: Click "Make a Variable" in the Variables category to keep track of things like score

change-variable.title: Update a variable
change-variable.text: Use "set" variable at the beginning, then "change" to update it. Try making a clicker game!

use-lists.title: Use lists
use-lists.text: Click "Make a List" under Variables to store a list of things, like names or numbers

detect-collision.title: Detect collisions
detect-collision.text: Use the "touching" block in a forever loop to check when a sprite touches the mouse pointer, the edge of the stage, or another sprite

broadcast-message.title: Send messages
broadcast-message.text: Use "broadcast" and "when I receive" to send messages. A different sprite can receive the message.

add-sprite.title: Add a sprite
add-sprite.text: Click the "add sprite" button below the stage to add a new sprite to your project

change-backdrop.title: Change backdrop
change-backdrop.text: Click the button below the stage to add a backdrop, then try "next backdrop"

make-game.title: Make a game
make-game.text: A simple game could start with keyboard controls, something to collect or avoid, and a variable to keep score

pointers.label: Drag "when key pressed" into your code

clone-sprite.title: Clone sprites
clone-sprite.text: Use "create clone" to make temporary copies of a sprite.

pointers.label: Drag "create clone of" into your code

add-extension.title: Add extensions
add-extension.text: Click the blue "Add Extension" button at the bottom-left to get extra blocks to do things like draw, play musical notes, or speak out loud.

sound-volume-zero.title: Fix volume
sound-volume-zero.text: Can't hear anything? Maybe the volume was set to 0. Use "set volume to 100%" to fix it!

pointers.label: Drag the "set volume" block into your code

sprite-is-hidden.title: Unhide sprite
sprite-is-hidden.text: Can't see your sprite? It might be hidden! Click the "show" eye icon in the sprite info area, or use the "show" block.

sprite-ghost-effect.title: Fade with ghost effect
sprite-ghost-effect.text: You can use the ghost effect to make your sprite fade out. Click the green flag or stop button to remove the effect.

sprite-off-stage.title: Find sprite
sprite-off-stage.text: You can use "go to x: 0 y: 0" to bring a sprite back to the center.

pointers.label: Drag "go to x: y:" into your code and set x and y to 0

stop-project.title: Stop everything
stop-project.text: Click the red stop button to stop all running scripts.

wrong-sprite-selected.title: Check which sprite
wrong-sprite-selected.text: Code not running? Make sure you added it to the right sprite! Click the sprite you want in the sprite pane, then check its code.

pointers.label: Click a sprite to see its code

touching-wrong-color.title: Fix color detection
touching-wrong-color.text: If "touching color" isn't working, make sure you picked the exact right color. Click the color on the block then use the eyedropper tool to select it from the stage.

wait-vs-no-wait.title: Add a wait
wait-vs-no-wait.text: If things happen too fast to see, try adding "wait" blocks between actions.

blocks-run-in-order.title: Block order
blocks-run-in-order.text: Blocks in a stack run one at a time, from top to bottom.

two-stacks-same-time.title: Do two things at once
two-stacks-same-time.text: You can run two stacks at the same time! Use two "when green flag clicked" blocks to do things in parallel.

pointers.label: Drag "when green flag clicked" into your code

if-not-forever.title: Keep checking
if-not-forever.text: "If" checks only once! Wrap it inside a "forever" loop to keep checking over and over.

click-block-to-try.title: Try a block
click-block-to-try.text: You can click on any block in the workspace to try it! Click a whole stack to run all of them. They'll highlight in yellow while they're running.

remove-block-from-stack.title: Remove a block
remove-block-from-stack.text: To remove a block from the middle of a stack, first drag away the ones under it. Then you can remove the block, and reconnect the rest.

batched-updates.title: Why no effect?
batched-updates.text: Blocks that undo each other (like "turn 15" then "turn -15") happen so fast you won't see anything. Try adding "wait" blocks between them.

negative-numbers.title: Go backward
negative-numbers.text: Use a minus sign (-) to make negative numbers. For example, "move -10 steps" makes your sprite go backward.

decimal-numbers.title: Use decimals
decimal-numbers.text: You can use decimal numbers like 0.5. Try "wait 0.5 seconds" for a shorter pause, or "move 0.5 steps" for smaller movements.

greater-less-than.title: Compare numbers
greater-less-than.text: The pointy symbols compare numbers: < means "less than" and > means "greater than." The open end faces the bigger number.

insert-reporter.title: Dynamic values
insert-reporter.text: You can drag any round reporter block into an input on another block to make it dynamic.

right-click-duplicate.title: Duplicate blocks
right-click-duplicate.text: Right-click on a block to duplicate it or add a comment.

change-xy-explanation.title: Stage coordinates
change-xy-explanation.text: The stage is like a grid: X goes left (-240) to right (240), and Y goes bottom (-180) to top (180), with center at (0, 0).

pen-extension.title: Draw with Pen
pen-extension.text: Add the Pen extension to draw lines and shapes as your sprite moves. Try "pen down" + "move" + "turn" in a loop.

music-extension.title: Play music
music-extension.text: Add the Music extension to play drums and instruments — use it in a loop to make a beat!

text-to-speech-extension.title: Sprite talks out loud
text-to-speech-extension.text: Add the Text to Speech extension to make your sprite actually talk out loud!

random-numbers.title: Use random
random-numbers.text: Use the "pick random" block for random positions, sizes, or colors

ask-and-answer.title: Ask a question
ask-and-answer.text: Use the "ask" block to ask the user a question. The response goes into the "answer" block.

pointers.label: Drag "ask and wait" into your code

timer-block.title: Use the timer
timer-block.text: Use the "timer" block to measure how long something takes.

change-size.title: Change size
change-size.text: Use "change size" to make your sprite grow or shrink

pointers.label: Drag "change size by" into your code

graphic-effects.title: Visual effects
graphic-effects.text: Try "set effect" to apply color, whirl, fisheye, ghost and other effects to your sprite

stamp-block.title: Stamp copies
stamp-block.text: Use "stamp" from the Pen extension to leave a picture of your sprite on the stage.

play-vs-play-until-done.title: Sound timing
play-vs-play-until-done.text: "Start sound" starts the sound then keeps going to the next block. "Play sound until done" waits for it to finish before continuing. Use the "until done" version for music loops.

pointers.label: Try the "play sound until done" block

backdrop-events.title: Backdrop triggers
backdrop-events.text: Use "when backdrop switches to" to do something when the scene changes.

pointers.label: Drag "when backdrop switches to" into your code

mouse-pointer.title: Follow mouse
mouse-pointer.text: Use "go to mouse-pointer" to make a sprite stick to your mouse!

show-hide-variable.title: Variable display
show-hide-variable.text: Check the box next to a variable in the menu to show its monitor on the stage. Right-click the monitor to change how it looks. You can make it a slider to tweak the values, too.

reset-at-start.title: Reset at start
reset-at-start.text: Put "go to x: y:" and "point in direction 90" under "when green flag clicked" to reset your sprite at the start.

pointers.label: Drag "go to x: y:" into your code

clone-delete.title: Delete clones
clone-delete.text: You can use "delete this clone" under "when I start as a clone" to make it go away.

pointers.label: Drag "delete this clone" into your code

repeat-until.title: Repeat until
repeat-until.text: Use "repeat until" to keep doing something until a condition is met, like moving until you reach the edge

color-changing.title: Rainbow colors
color-changing.text: Put "change color effect" inside a forever loop to make your sprite cycle through rainbow colors

pointers.label: Drag "change color effect" into your code

spinning.title: Spin around
spinning.text: Put "turn 15 degrees" inside a forever loop to make your sprite spin! Change the number to spin faster or slower.

growing-shrinking.title: Pulse effect
growing-shrinking.text: Make your sprite pulse! Use "change size by 5" and "wait", then "change size by -5" and "wait" in a forever loop.

pointers.label: Drag "change size by" into your code

sound-remix.title: Remix sounds
sound-remix.text: Use "change pitch effect" to make sounds higher or lower

rotation-style-vs-turn.title: Fix rotation
rotation-style-vs-turn.text: If "turn" doesn't seem to work, check the rotation style in the sprite info area. If it's is set to "left-right" or "don't rotate", change it to "all around."

pointers.label: Check rotation style in sprite info

costume-center.title: Fix costume center
costume-center.text: If your sprite rotates weirdly, the costume center point might be off. Go to the Costumes tab and center your drawing on the crosshairs.

tutorial-getting-started.title: Getting Started tutorial
tutorial-getting-started.text: Learn how to make a sprite move and say hello!

tutorial-getting-started-asl.title: Getting Started - ASL tutorial
tutorial-getting-started-asl.text: Learn Scratch with American Sign Language!

tutorial-animate-a-name.title: Animate a Name tutorial
tutorial-animate-a-name.text: Make letters spin, grow, and change color!

tutorial-animate-a-character.title: Animate a Character tutorial
tutorial-animate-a-character.text: Make a character talk, move with arrow keys, and jump!

tutorial-tell-a-story.title: Create a Story tutorial
tutorial-tell-a-story.text: Make characters have conversations and switch scenes!

tutorial-say-it-out-loud.title: Create Animations That Talk tutorial
tutorial-say-it-out-loud.text: Use the text-to-speech extension and make sprites speak out loud!

tutorial-imagine.title: Imagine a World tutorial
tutorial-imagine.text: Create an interactive world with flying, gliding, and costume changes!

tutorial-add-effects.title: Add Effects tutorial
tutorial-add-effects.text: Learn about color, fisheye, whirl, pixelate, and other cool effects!

tutorial-make-it-fly.title: Make it Fly tutorial
tutorial-make-it-fly.text: Create a flying game with arrow keys, collectibles, and a score!

tutorial-make-music.title: Make Music tutorial
tutorial-make-music.text: Pick instruments, create songs, and make a beatbox!

tutorial-pong.title: Pong Game tutorial
tutorial-pong.text: Make a ball bounce off a paddle and keep score!

tutorial-clicker-game.title: Make a Clicker Game tutorial
tutorial-clicker-game.text: Make things pop up, click on them, and keep score!

tutorial-chase-game.title: Chase Game tutorial
tutorial-chase-game.text: Make a game where you chase things around the screen with arrow keys!

tutorial-video-sensing.title: Video Sensing tutorial
tutorial-video-sensing.text: Use your camera to pet the cat, animate sprites, and pop balloons!

tutorial-face-sensing.title: Face Sensing tutorial
tutorial-face-sensing.text: Put accessories on your face and make games that use face tracking!

tutorial-talking-tales.title: Talking Tales tutorial
tutorial-talking-tales.text: Make characters speak, switch scenes, dance, and ask questions!

tutorial-add-sprite.title: Add a Sprite tutorial
tutorial-add-sprite.text: Learn how to add new characters to your project!

tutorial-add-backdrop.title: Add a Backdrop tutorial
tutorial-add-backdrop.text: Learn how to change the background of your project!

tutorial-arrow-keys.title: Use Arrow Keys tutorial
tutorial-arrow-keys.text: Learn how to move a sprite around with the keyboard!

tutorial-change-size.title: Change Size tutorial
tutorial-change-size.text: Learn how to make sprites grow and shrink!

tutorial-glide-around.title: Glide Around tutorial
tutorial-glide-around.text: Make your sprite glide smoothly back and forth or to a point!

tutorial-make-it-spin.title: Make It Spin tutorial
tutorial-make-it-spin.text: Learn how to make a sprite turn and set its direction!

tutorial-record-a-sound.title: Record a Sound tutorial
tutorial-record-a-sound.text: Record your own sounds and use them in your project!

tutorial-animate-a-sprite.title: Animate a Sprite tutorial
tutorial-animate-a-sprite.text: Learn how to switch costumes and create animations!

starter-dance-party.title: Dance Party
starter-dance-party.text: Shows how to make characters dance by switching costumes in a forever loop while the stage plays music

starter-animate-crab.title: Animate the Crab
starter-animate-crab.text: Shows how to bring a character to life with costume expressions, "if on edge bounce," and random positioning!

starter-walk-cycle.title: Walk Cycle
starter-walk-cycle.text: Shows how to create a realistic walking animation by combining "move steps" with "next costume" in a repeat loop!

starter-mouse-trail.title: Mouse Trail
starter-mouse-trail.text: Shows how to use cloning to create a trail of stars that follows your mouse, with each clone shrinking and disappearing!

starter-food-truck.title: Food Truck Animation
starter-food-truck.text: Shows how to make a scrolling background, spinning tires, and flashing graphic effects with multiple sprites!

starter-make-it-fly.title: Make It Fly
starter-make-it-fly.text: Shows how to use keyboard controls to make a flying cat dodge scrolling buildings

starter-maze.title: Maze Starter
starter-maze.text: Shows how to navigate a ball through a maze using arrow keys, with color touching detection for wall collisions

starter-dress-up.title: Dress Up Tera
starter-dress-up.text: Shows how to make sprites draggable and detect if a sprite is touching another sprite to create an interactive dress-up game

starter-pong.title: Pong Starter
starter-pong.text: Shows how to make a simple game including mouse movement, ball bouncing, collisions, and sound effects

starter-hide-seek.title: Hide and Seek
starter-hide-seek.text: Shows how to make a clicker game with a score variable, random positioning, and show and hide

starter-stamp-studio.title: Stamp Studio
starter-stamp-studio.text: Shows how to use the pen stamp block with if-then conditions to draw colorful patterns that follow your mouse

starter-parallax.title: Interactive Parallax
starter-parallax.text: Shows how to use math operators and mouse sensing to move layers at different speeds for a depth effect!

starter-soundflower.title: Soundflower
starter-soundflower.text: Shows how to use the loudness and multiply blocks to make a flower that responds to your microphone

starter-art-alive.title: Make Art Come Alive
starter-art-alive.text: Shows how to use click events, broadcasts, and glide blocks to animate parts of a painting

starter-spin-art.title: Spin Art
starter-spin-art.text: Shows how to use variable sliders, the stamp block, and movement to create mesmerizing spiral patterns!

starter-dj.title: DJ Scratch Cat
starter-dj.text: Shows how to use key press events and sound blocks to make a DJ mixing board with a looping beat!

starter-piano.title: Piano
starter-piano.text: Shows how to build a playable instrument with clickable key sprites using the Music extension's play note block!

starter-fish-pitch.title: Catch the Fish
starter-fish-pitch.text: Shows how to use cloning, a score variable, and the pitch effect to make music play higher as you score!

starter-fur-elise.title: Fur Elise
starter-fur-elise.text: Shows how to use custom My Blocks to organize a song into reusable sections with the Music extension!

starter-drum-sequencer.title: Drum Sequencer
starter-drum-sequencer.text: Shows how to use clones to make a row of buttons, and color sensing to trigger sounds

starter-story.title: Story Starter
starter-story.text: Shows how to make characters take turns talking with the broadcast and when I receive blocks

starter-random-facts.title: Random Facts
starter-random-facts.text: Shows how to create a slideshow presentation using backdrops and key press events!

starter-fill-blanks.title: Fill in the Blanks
starter-fill-blanks.text: Shows how to make a mad-libs story using the ask block, variables, and the join block

starter-stop-motion.title: Stop Motion
starter-stop-motion.text: Shows how to create a flipbook-style animation by switching costumes in a forever loop!

starter-adventure.title: Adventure Game
starter-adventure.text: Shows how to build an interactive adventure with collision detection and broadcast-driven scene changes!

starter-gravity.title: Gravity Example
starter-gravity.text: Shows how to simulate gravity with velocity variables and conditionals for ground collision!

starter-sound-graph.title: Sound Graph
starter-sound-graph.text: Shows how to visualize microphone input as a graph using pen blocks, loudness sensing, and math operators

starter-math-game.title: Math Game
starter-math-game.text: Shows how to make a quiz with random number variables, ask blocks for input, and if-else to check answers!

starter-circuit.title: Circuit Simulation
starter-circuit.text: Shows how to use draggable sprites, color-touching detection, and boolean logic to simulate a circuit!

starter-coordinates.title: X and Y Coordinates
starter-coordinates.text: Shows how the Scratch coordinate system works by letting you drag a sprite and see its position update!

starter-text-speech.title: Text to Speech
starter-text-speech.text: Shows how to make your characters speak out loud

starter-pen-flower.title: Pen Flower
starter-pen-flower.text: Shows how to use nested repeat loops and pen blocks to draw a colorful pattern of rotating squares!

starter-musical-droplets.title: Musical Droplets
starter-musical-droplets.text: Shows how to use clones, the Music extension, and math to turn mouse position into musical notes!

starter-translate.title: Translate This!
starter-translate.text: Shows how to use the Translate extension to make characters speak in different languages!

starter-face-filter.title: Face Filter
starter-face-filter.text: Shows how to use the Face Sensing extension to make hats and glasses follow your face in real time!

starter-greeting-card.title: Greeting Card
starter-greeting-card.text: Shows how to make an interactive card with backdrop switches, glide animations, and sound effects!

starter-quiz.title: Community Quiz
starter-quiz.text: Shows how to build a quiz with custom blocks, ask-and-wait input, if-else logic, and Text-to-Speech!

starter-trophy.title: Small Wins Trophy
starter-trophy.text: Shows how to click on sprite parts to cycle through costumes and design a custom award!

starter-kindness.title: Acts of Kindness
starter-kindness.text: Shows how to pick a random item from a list using  the pick random block

starter-paper-plane.title: Paper Plane Tutorial
starter-paper-plane.text: Shows how to make a step-by-step guide with broadcasts, repeat-until loops, and costume switching!

follow-another-sprite.title: Follow a sprite
follow-another-sprite.text: Use "point towards [sprite]" and a move block inside a "forever" loop to make one sprite follow another.

pointers.label: Drag out "point towards" and select a sprite from the menu

bounce-up-down.title: Bounce up & down
bounce-up-down.text: One way to bounce is "repeat 10: change y by 5" then "repeat 10: change y by -5" inside a forever loop.

pointers.label: Drag "change y by" into your code

duplicate-code-to-sprite.title: Copy code to sprite
duplicate-code-to-sprite.text: You can drag a stack of blocks from onto a another sprite in the sprite selector, to copy it there.

pointers.label: Drag code onto a sprite to copy it

face-without-flip.title: Face left (no flip)
face-without-flip.text: Set rotation style to "left-right" in the sprite info area — then your sprite will flip horizontally without going upside down!

pointers.label: Set rotation style in sprite info

continuous-key-hold.title: Hold key to move
continuous-key-hold.text: Use "forever if key pressed" instead of "when key pressed" for smooth, continuous movement

sprite-return-to-position.title: Go back to start
sprite-return-to-position.text: Use "go to x: 0 y: 0" to send a sprite back to the center

pointers.label: Drag "go to x: y:" into your code and change the numbers

insert-audio-file.title: Upload a sound
insert-audio-file.text: To add your own audio file, go to the Sounds tab, hover over the speaker button, and choose "Upload Sound" to pick a file from your computer

falling-obstacle.title: Falling obstacles
falling-obstacle.text: To make a sprite fall from the sky, start it at the top with "go to x:0 y:180" then use "forever: change y by -5" to make it fall down!

pointers.label: Drag "change y by" into your code

find-sprite-x-position.title: Find X position
find-sprite-x-position.text: Select a sprite to see its x and y position in the sprite info area below, or use the "x position" reporter block

pointers.label: See x and y position here
Check the box to show the x position

glide-to-random.title: Random glide
glide-to-random.text: Use "glide" to move smoothly to a random position, to your mouse pointer, or to another sprite.

change-y-position.title: Change y
change-y-position.text: Use "change y by" for up and down movement

pointers.label: Drag "change y by" into your code

translate-extension.title: Translate text
translate-extension.text: Add the Translate extension to make your sprite say words in another language

video-sensing-extension.title: Video Sensing
video-sensing-extension.text: Add the Video Sensing extension to use your webcam to sense movement.

face-sensing-extension.title: Track your face
face-sensing-extension.text: Add the Face Sensing extension to make a sprite stick to your nose, mouth, or eyes!

makeymakey-extension.title: Makey Makey input
makeymakey-extension.text: Use the Makey Makey extension with a Makey Makey board. Or trying adding a secret code to your project.

point-direction.title: Point in direction
point-direction.text: Use "point in direction" to face a specific way: 90 = right, -90 = left, 0 = up, 180 = down.

pointers.label: Drag "point in direction" into your code

point-towards.title: Point at something
point-towards.text: Use "point towards" to face the mouse pointer or another sprite

if-on-edge-bounce.title: Bounce off edges
if-on-edge-bounce.text: Add "if on edge, bounce" inside a forever loop so your sprite turns when it hits the edge of the stage.

pointers.label: Drag "if on edge, bounce" into your code

set-size-to.title: Set exact size
set-size-to.text: Use "set size to 100" for normal size. Try 50 for half size, or 200 for double size.

pointers.label: Drag "set size to" into your code

hide-sprite.title: Hide a sprite
hide-sprite.text: Use "hide" to make a sprite invisible, and "show" to make it appear again.

stop-all-sounds.title: Stop sounds
stop-all-sounds.text: Use "stop all sounds" to silence everything that's playing

pointers.label: Drag "stop all sounds" into your code

sprite-clicked.title: When sprite clicked
sprite-clicked.text: Use "when this sprite clicked" to make a sprite react to clicks.

pointers.label: Drag "when this sprite clicked" into your code

broadcast-and-wait.title: Broadcast and wait
broadcast-and-wait.text: Use "broadcast and wait" to send a message and wait there until every receiver finishes running code that was triggered by it.

pointers.label: Drag "broadcast and wait" into your code

if-else-block.title: If / else
if-else-block.text: Use "if / else" to do one thing when a condition is true and a different thing otherwise.

wait-until-block.title: Wait until
wait-until-block.text: Use "wait until" to pause your code until something happens, like a sprite touching another, or a key being pressed.

distance-to.title: Measure distance
distance-to.text: Use "distance to" to find how far away the mouse pointer or another sprite is.

loudness-block.title: Sense loudness
loudness-block.text: Use "loudness" to react to your microphone.

mouse-down-block.title: Click and hold
mouse-down-block.text: Use "mouse down?" to check if the mouse button is being held down.

equals-comparison.title: Compare with equals
equals-comparison.text: Use the "=" operator to check if two things match, like comparing the answer to a quiz question.

join-strings.title: Join words
join-strings.text: Use "join" to combine chunks of text.

make-a-block.title: Make your own block
make-a-block.text: Click "Make a Block" in the My Blocks category to define your own custom block

tip-exploring-ai-face-sensing.title: Exploring AI with Scratch Face Sensing Blocks
tip-exploring-ai-face-sensing.text: Explore AI by using Scratch's face sensing blocks to make interactive projects.

tip-conditionals-part-1.title: Conditional Statements: Make Interactive Projects (Part 1)
tip-conditionals-part-1.text: Use if-then blocks to make your projects respond to what's happening.

tip-virtual-pet.title: How to Make a Virtual Pet in Scratch
tip-virtual-pet.text: Build a virtual pet you can feed, play with, and care for.

tip-catch-game.title: How to Make a Catch Game in Scratch
tip-catch-game.text: Make a game where a sprite catches falling objects.

tip-create-sprite-paint-editor.title: Create a Sprite with the Scratch Paint Editor
tip-create-sprite-paint-editor.text: Draw your own sprite from scratch using the paint editor.

tip-variables-lists-part-1.title: What Are Variables and Lists in Scratch? (Part 1)
tip-variables-lists-part-1.text: Learn what variables and lists are and why projects use them.

tip-conditionals-part-2.title: Conditional Statements: Nesting, Debugging, and Beyond (Part 2)
tip-conditionals-part-2.text: Go deeper with conditionals: nesting, debugging, and combining them.

tip-pong-game.title: How to Make a Pong Game in Scratch
